Despite EDR/NDR detecting suspicious behaviors and IDS generating alerts, sandbox analysis incorrectly classified payloads as clean, contributing to delayed response. Response actions were denied due to incorrect targeting (10.0.5.14 instead of 10.0.5.42), exposing a critical gap in incident data correlation.
